entities.name: Tawhid Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Tawhid Mosque is a mosque in Aleppo, Syria, located on Khalil al-Hindawi street, on the right bank of the Queiq River. It was opened in 1981 and features a combined style of the early Islamic Abbasid and modern mosque architecture.
